recreation.gov search API (name + 5-mile radius, 2026-11-20): no East Fork listing -> first-come only, matching the FS page

Esri World Imagery 2026-11-20 (250 m half-width at 44.5970,-107.2080): the campground spurs sit in a conifer strip SE of a wide marshy meadow, around 44.5953-44.5962, -107.2095 to -107.2083 (the FS point is among them); East Fork Big Goose Creek meanders through the meadow ~75-100 m NW of the spurs, with willow/marsh between; the stored pin (44.5980,-107.2079) is in the open meadow ~240 m north of the sites

values.note: Memorial Day to Labor Day, weather permitting (2027 dates); after that, self-supported camping with no water or trash as long as weather permits.

season.source: FS page ('Seasons of Use: Memorial Day - Labor Day, weather dependent'; 'open to self-supported camping as long as weather permits after season closures'), read 2026-11-20

note: Small Bighorn NF campground on the East Fork of Big Goose Creek, about two miles north of Park Reservoir. The FS route is from Sheridan: WY-332 and WY-335, then about 11 miles on Red Grade/Big Goose Road (FSR 26). --Claude
summary: FS page (updated 2026-09-08) read: FCFS only (no rec.gov), 14-day limit, $20 (8 people, extra-vehicle fee), vault toilets + water, Memorial Day-Labor Day then self-supported. Facilities, booking, fees, season written. Not waterfront holds. RE-PIN 44.5980,-107.2079 -> 44.59591,-107.20869 (~240 m). Phone empty -> 307-674-2600. Unsourced 'Dayton route for RVs' line removed.
flags: PIN: 44.5980,-107.2079 -> 44.59591,-107.20869 (FS point; Google 44.5959063,-107.2086901; the spurs are in the conifer strip around it). The stored pin is ~240 m north in the open creek meadow - just under the 250 m line, but on no campsite.

ACCESS: the old note said 'Access via Dayton/WY-335 recommended for RVs (Big Horn side road is steep/unpaved)'. No agency source says this, and it mixes up the routes: WY-335 IS the Big Horn/Red Grade approach from Sheridan, which is the route the FS page gives. The FS page has no 4WD, clearance or RV warning. Line removed; the note now gives the FS route.
SITES: the current FS page gives no site count or length; stored count 11 and max_rig_ft 50 (from the older page via the inclusion evidence) left as stored.
WATERFRONT stored 'not waterfront': HOLDS (sites in conifers ~75-100 m from the creek across willow marsh; the creek is well under 30 m wide).
SEASON: Memorial Day to Labor Day written as 2027 dates (05-31 to 09-06); the page is currently 'Partially Closed' (self-supported camping as weather permits).
PHONE: empty -> 307-674-2600 (Bighorn NF Supervisor's / Tongue Ranger District office, FS page and Google).
